subject.title: [Feature]: `announceTarget` option for sub-agent completion announce routing

question: Should OpenClaw add a public native subagent completion-routing contract named `announceTarget: "channel" | "parent"`, and should it exist both per-spawn and as `agents.defaults.subagents.announceTarget`?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix adds model-facing tool API and config/default surface that changes whether completion events reach an external channel or wake the parent session.

options.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
options.body: Add `announceTarget` to both `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default it to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session without direct channel delivery.

options.title: Approve per-spawn only
options.body: Add only an explicit per-call override first to avoid expanding global config while still enabling orchestrator-controlled handoffs.

options.title: Defer native routing
options.body: Keep current depth-based delivery and require users to use explicit callbacks or wait for a broader handoff contract before adding public routing surface.

recommendation.title: Approve per-spawn plus config default
recommendation.body: Add `announceTarget` to both `sessions_spawn` and `agents.defaults.subagents`, default it to current channel behavior, and route `parent` completions into the requester session without direct channel delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced `sessions_spawn` and has the strongest history signal across the public tool, announce delivery, and contract documentation surfaces.
